digest.component_or_area: structured-output orchestration, RP-01 Pydantic AI migration
propositions: Pydantic AI 1.107.2 output, retry, fallback, and limits seams must preserve all 15 historical ticket authorities (wake-thud-pip, stripy-wishful-hartebeest, candied-snippy-schnauzer, floaty-precious-rodent, brimstony-drear-seahorse, gnomish-nosophobic-arawana, strange-gargantuan-norwayrat, puerile-defensive-nighthawk, cheatable-impressed-waxwing, splurgy-tangible-halicore, chief-contained-hoopoe, unverified-trigonous-flounder, sorry-clay-anole, rebel-vaporous-martin, sitophobic-dreamlike-seahorse) and their 16 deduplicated behavior matrix rows validated by 290 passing unit tests.

Three unresolved maintainer decisions remain: successful-retry usage accounting (recommend aggregate operation-wide tokens, not per-attempt), retry-response wire shape (approve complete-or-nothing with no prefix truncation, count-token fitting, and conciseness guidance), and Pydantic-vs-Rebar retry-loop ownership (constraint: preserve three total attempts, early success, deterministic repair, stop-reason fast-fail, cumulative usage, public error translation, final-failure artifact timing).

Offline probe exercised 32 declared observations covering NativeOutput, PromptedOutput schema injection, repairable rejection, multi-object/decoy rejection, successful/exhausted output retry, request/tool/output-token limits, FallbackModel predicates, provider errors, truncation/refusal, telemetry hooks, and artifact capture without live model calls; all 19 core observations passed.

Pydantic AI 1.107.2 does not implement Rebar's deterministic repair, schema/sentinel candidate extraction, or stop-reason fast-fail; vanilla PromptedOutput with retries failed repairable near miss and decoy-plus-valid cases that Rebar deterministically recovers.

Cache and context-window impact measured: same-run output retry read 64% more cached tokens (+1,536) and wrote 84% less (-1,532); ProcessHistory truncates stored responses destructively (5,000→2,013 characters) making prefix truncation unsafe for validation error attribution and completeness recovery.

Successful-retry exhaustion translation requires cause-chain inspection to recover Rebar-owned types; failed-attempt accounting and candidate-request tracking require explicit telemetry counters separate from Agent request_limit, with optional non-blocking count_tokens calls per viable candidate.
